exam_facts.test: Multiple well-demarcated, hypopigmented macules and patches over the face, hands, and arms.
Skin texture is normal within and around the lesions.
Absence of melanocytes in the epidermis.

exam_facts.result: WBC 5.2 × 10⁹/L, neutrophils 62%, lymphocytes 28%, hemoglobin 14.3 g/dL, hematocrit 42.1%, platelets 245 × 10⁹/L

Sodium 140 mmol/L, potassium 4.2 mmol/L, chloride 102 mmol/L, bicarbonate 24 mmol/L, BUN 10 mg/dL, creatinine 0.9 mg/dL, glucose 88 mg/dL, calcium 9.4 mg/dL, albumin 4.1 g/dL, total protein 7.2 g/dL, AST 22 U/L, ALT 18 U/L, ALP 68 U/L, total bilirubin 0.6 mg/dL
TSH 1.8 mIU/L, free T4 1.1 ng/dL, total T3 102 ng/dL

Antithyroid peroxidase (TPO) antibody 12 IU/mL (normal < 34), antithyroglobulin antibody 18 IU/mL (normal < 40), antinuclear antibody (ANA) titer 1:40 with homogeneous pattern, anti-dsDNA < 10 IU/mL, anti-SSA/Ro and anti-SSB/La negative
Color pale yellow, clarity clear, specific gravity 1.015, pH 6.0, no glucose, no protein, no blood, no leukocyte esterase, no nitrites, 0–1 WBC/hpf, 0 RBC/hpf, no casts
Well-demarcated, sharply bordered lesions show bright, uniform cobalt-white fluorescence under 365 nm light
No hyphae or spores identified in skin scrapings from lesional and perilesional margins
No granulomatous inflammation, no acid-fast bacilli on Fite stain, normal nerve architecture
Vitamin B12 412 pg/mL, serum folate 12.3 ng/mL
RPR nonreactive, confirmatory Treponema pallidum particle agglutination (TPPA) negative
Normal thyroid size and echotexture; no nodules, no increased vascularity, no lymphadenopathy
